title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water)
scope_summary: Requirements for packaged drinking water other than mineral water.
certification_route: Mandatory Scheme-I Factory Audit + Lab Testing
verification_note: Source dataset listed "IS 14543:2024" — no such edition exists. Current specification is IS 14543:2016 (Third Revision); a QCO guideline amendment was issued 2024-11-05, which is likely what got conflated into an edition year.
source_note: Official BIS product manual PDF (also used as seed data in the main app, data/seed/manifest.json)

title: Packaged Natural Mineral Water
scope_summary: Natural mineral water packaged directly at source.
verification_note: Source dataset listed "IS 13428:2024" — no such edition exists. Current specification is IS 13428:2005.
source_note: Official BIS product manual PDF

title: Whole Milk Powder — Specification (Sixth Revision)
scope_summary: Moisture, fat content, and hygiene for whole milk powder.
verification_note: Source dataset listed "IS 1165:2020" and title "Milk Powder Specification" — current edition is IS 1165:2022 (Sixth Revision), titled "Whole Milk Powder — Specification".
source_note: Internet Archive mirror of the official BIS standard; a direct bis.gov.in PDF was not located this session

title: Infant Food — Follow-Up Formula (First Revision)
scope_summary: Nutritional standards for follow-up formula, the liquid weaning-diet component for infants from 6 months to 2 years.
verification_note: Source dataset listed "IS 15757:2007" — that edition existed but was superseded by IS 15757:2022 (First Revision, amendments established 2022-09-28). Listing the 2007 edition as current is stale.
source_note: Secondary/certification-aggregator source — an official bis.gov.in or archive.org record for the 2022 edition specifically was not located this session; treat the edition year (2022) as needing a primary-source re-check before relying on it.

title: Information Technology Equipment — Safety, Part 1: General Requirements (Second Revision)
scope_summary: Safety requirements (electric shock, fire, overheating) for IT equipment including laptops, power adaptors, mobile handsets, and POS machines. Identical under dual numbering with IEC 60950-1:2005.
certification_route: Scheme-II CRS Self-Declaration via Recognized Lab
verification_note: Confirmed as stated in the source dataset.
source_note: Official BIS Connect standard-details page

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes — Safety Requirements for Portable Sealed Secondary Lithium Cells and Batteries
scope_summary: Safety and short-circuit testing for portable lithium rechargeable batteries. Equivalent to IEC 62133-2:2017.
verification_note: Confirmed as stated in the source dataset.
source_note: Official BIS CRS portal guideline document

title: Audio, Video and Similar Electronic Apparatus — Safety Requirements (Fifth Revision)
scope_summary: Safety standards for televisions (non-Plasma/LCD/LED), speakers, power amplifiers, and similar apparatus. Equivalent to IEC 60065:2014.
verification_note: Confirmed as stated in the source dataset.
source_note: Official BIS test-report-format PDF

title: Mobile Phone Handsets, Part 3: Indian Language Support — Specific Requirements (Second Revision)
scope_summary: Font rendering, Unicode UTF-8 support, and message readability for at least 22 scheduled Indian regional languages on mobile handsets.
verification_note: Confirmed as stated in the source dataset. Supersedes IS 16333 (Part 3):2017, withdrawn 2022-12-17.
source_note: Internet Archive mirror of the official BIS standard

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances, Part 2: Particular Requirements, Section 6: Induction Cooking Range (Induction Stove)
scope_summary: Electrical safety and thermal protection for induction cooktops.
verification_note: Source dataset listed "IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 26):2014" for induction cookers. Section 26 of IS 302 Part 2 is actually the standard for clocks, not induction cookers — a materially different product. The real induction-cooker standard is IS 302 (Part 2/Section 6):2009.
source_note: Secondary/certification-aggregator source — an official bis.gov.in or archive.org PDF was not located this session; re-verify against a primary source before treating as fully authoritative.

title: Domestic Pressure Cookers — Specification
scope_summary: Safety valves, thermal proofing, and bursting-pressure limits for aluminium and stainless-steel pressure cookers, 1–22 litre nominal capacity.
verification_note: Confirmed as stated in the source dataset.
source_note: Secondary/certification-aggregator source — an official bis.gov.in or archive.org PDF was not located this session.

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances, Part 2: Particular Requirements, Section 3: Electric Iron (First Revision)
scope_summary: Insulation, temperature control, and earthing for domestic electric dry and steam irons up to 250V.
verification_note: Confirmed as stated in the source dataset. Note: a Second Revision, IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 3):2024 (aligned to IEC 60335-2-3:2022), has since been published — check whether it has superseded the 2007 edition before relying on this for a current certification pathway.
source_note: Internet Archive mirror of the official BIS standard

title: Domestic Electric Food-Mixers (Liquidisers and Grinders) — Specification (Second Revision)
scope_summary: Motor safety, blade stability, and electrical insulation for electric motor-driven food mixers/grinders (mixies) up to 250V, for home use.
verification_note: Source dataset listed "IS 4250:1980" as current. That edition was real but has been superseded by IS 4250:2025 (Second Revision), with a compliance transition period to September 2025.
source_note: News/secondary source reporting the revision — an official bis.gov.in PDF for the 2025 edition was not located this session; historical 1980 edition is archived at https://archive.org/details/gov.in.is.4250.1980

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances, Part 2: Particular Requirements, Section 201: Electric Immersion Water-Heater
scope_summary: Submersion dielectric breakdown and physical shock protection for portable electric immersion water heaters up to 250V. Equivalent to IEC 60335-2-74.
verification_note: Confirmed as stated in the source dataset.
source_note: Internet Archive mirror of the official BIS standard

title: Protective Helmets for Two-Wheeler Riders — Specification (Fourth Revision)
scope_summary: Impact attenuation, retention strap, and optical visor clarity for protective helmets, 500–620mm head-form sizes.
verification_note: Source dataset listed "IS 4151:2020" — no such edition exists. The current standard is IS 4151:2015 (Fourth Revision); the Protective Helmet for Two Wheeler Riders (Quality Control) Order, 2020 is the regulatory order that mandates compliance with IS 4151:2015 — the "2020" belongs to the order, not the standard.
source_note: Official BIS product manual PDF

title: High Visibility Warning Clothes — Specification (First Revision)
scope_summary: Colour, retro-reflectivity, and design requirements for high-visibility protective clothing used in road, rail, airport, mining, and industrial settings.
verification_note: Confirmed as stated in the source dataset. Mandatory BIS certification effective 2023-10-07.
source_note: Internet Archive mirror of the official BIS standard

title: Industrial Safety Helmets — Specification (Second Revision)
scope_summary: Material, design, and performance requirements for industrial safety helmets used in construction, mining, shipbuilding, and tunnelling.
verification_note: Confirmed as stated in the source dataset — this remains the current active edition.
source_note: Official BIS Connect standard listing PDF

title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules — Design Qualification and Type Approval (First Revision)
scope_summary: Thermal cycling, damp heat, mechanical load, and hail-impact qualification for commercial crystalline-silicon solar PV modules. Identical to IEC 61215:2005.
verification_note: Confirmed as stated in the source dataset. A 2023 revision exists with concurrent validity permitted until 2027-02-15 — this 2010 edition is still current for now.
source_note: law.resource.org mirror of the official BIS standard

title: Power Converters for Use in Photovoltaic Power Systems — Part 2: Particular Requirements for Inverters
scope_summary: Anti-islanding and grid protection for grid-connected and off-grid rooftop solar inverters up to 150kW. Harmonised with IEC 62109.
verification_note: Source dataset listed "IS 16221 (Part 2):2016" — the confirmed edition year is 2015, not 2016.
source_note: Secondary/certification-aggregator source — an official bis.gov.in or archive.org PDF was not located this session.

title: Grades of Gold and Gold Alloys for Jewellery/Artefacts
scope_summary: Mandatory 3-sign hallmark: BIS logo, purity grade (14/18/20/22/23/24 carat), and 6-digit HUID code, for gold jewellery and artefacts.
certification_route: Manakonline Jeweller Registration + AHC Laser Marking
verification_note: Confirmed as stated in the source dataset. Mandatory hallmarking effective 2021-06-15.
source_note: Official BIS page — does not cite the specific edition year directly; corroborated by secondary sources for "2016"

title: Silver and Silver Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts — Fineness and Marking — Specification (Third Revision)
scope_summary: Voluntary hallmarking fineness standards (six grades: 800/835/900/925/970/990) for silver articles.
verification_note: Confirmed as stated in the source dataset, including the voluntary (non-mandatory) status. Note: IS 2112:2025 has since been published, adding grades 958 and 999 — check whether it has superseded this 2014 edition before relying on it for a current certification pathway.
source_note: Internet Archive mirror of the official BIS standard
